core.name: Terminating Verdict
core.text:
Trick of Fate hits, or Stunning an enemy, give Dark Abyss Reverb for 6s: +12% CRIT Rate and +25% CRIT DMG. ATK +{0} with 1 / 2 Stun Agents in the squad.
Totalize: when the Finishing Move of Punishment or Blaspheme hits a Stunned enemy, its multiplier rises by {1}%, plus {2}% per second of Stun left (first 5s) and {3}% per second (5–15s), up to {4}%. It then ends the Stun and refunds Daze: 5% per second left, max 25% of the enemy's max Daze.
Punishment deals 20% more Daze to enemies that aren't Stunned.
